name: High job demands
description: Too much work, unrealistic deadlines, or constant time pressure.

name: Low job demands
description: Not enough meaningful work, repetitive tasks, or skills going unused.

name: Job control
description: Little say in how you do your work or when tasks get done.

name: Support
description: Not getting the help you need from managers, colleagues, or the company.

name: Role clarity
description: Uncertain about your responsibilities or what's expected of you.

name: Change management
description: Changes happening without warning, explanation, or consultation.

name: Recognition and reward
description: Your work is rarely acknowledged or rewarded.

name: Fairness
description: Inconsistent rules, bias, or unfair decisions.

name: Traumatic events
description: Witnessing or experiencing distressing or traumatic incidents at work.

name: Remote/isolated work
description: Working alone or remotely with limited access to others or support.

name: Physical environment
description: Workplace conditions that negatively affect your safety or comfort.

name: Violence and aggression
description: Physical threats, attacks, or aggressive behaviour from others.

name: Bullying
description: Repeated unreasonable behaviour that intimidates, humiliates, or undermines you.

name: Harassment
description: Unwelcome conduct, including sexual or other forms of harassment.

name: Workplace relationships
description: Ongoing tension, disputes, or difficult relationships with colleagues.
